title: Grouparoo Destination Freshness SLA
app: Grouparoo run events via the Grouparoo API/logs to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=grouparoo:run state="complete"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by destination
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>6
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each Grouparoo destination and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A destination can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for Grouparoo.
implementation: Ingest Grouparoo success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical destination exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of destination by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of Grouparoo has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
